options.name: action
options.description: An optional action (entry in the progressTrail). Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: activityTemplate
options.description: An optional change activity template ID. Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: activityType
options.description: The activity type. Default is V(normal). Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: add
options.description:
The properties to add to an existing change. At least one of O(add), O(replace), or O(remove) is required when O(state=update). Ignored for other states.
The elements in the list of items to add should have a path (leading slash not needed) and a value property.

options.name: assigneeId
options.description: The ID of the assignee. If no assigneeId is given, the group ID is used. Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: assigneegroupId
options.description: The group ID of the assignee. If no assigneeId is given, this is also used for the assignee. Required when O(state=new), ignored for other states.

options.name: briefDescription
options.description: The brief description of the change activity. Only the first 80 characters will be used if a longer description is given. Required when O(state=new), ignored for other states.

options.name: category
options.description: The ID or name of the category. If not provided, the category from the change is used. Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: changeActivityId
options.description: The ID of the change activity to manipulate. Ignored when O(state=new), required for other states.

options.name: changeId
options.description: The ID of the change to which the change activity belongs. Required when O(state=new), ignored for other states.

options.name: changePhase
options.description: The phase for the change activity. Default is V(progress). Ignored when O(state<>new).

options.name: debug
options.description: Whether to include some debugging in the output or not.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file to upload to the change. Required when O(state=upload).

options.name: plannedDays
options.description: The number of days until the planned end date. Overruled when plannedEndDate is also provided. Note that weekends and holidays are not looked at.

options.name: plannedEndDate
options.description:
The end date of the change activity, in the format '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00%z'. By default, the activity ends 1 day after the time of creation.
If both plannedDays and plannedEndDate are given, plannedDays is ignored. Note that weekends and holidays are not looked at.

options.name: plannedStartDate
options.description: The start date of the change activity, in the format '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00%z'. By default, the activity starts at the time of creation.

options.name: remove
options.description:
The properties to remove to an existing change. At least one of O(add), O(replace), or O(remove) is required when O(state=update). Ignored for other states.
The elements in the list of items to remove should only have a path (leading slash not needed) property.

options.name: replace
options.description:
The properties to replace on an existing change. At least one of O(add), O(replace), or O(remove) is required when O(state=update). Ignored for other states.
The elements in the list of items to replace should have a path (leading slash not needed) and a value property.

options.name: request
options.description: The request text. Required when O(state=new), ignored for other states.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the change activity.

options.name: status
options.description: The ID or name of the status. Required when O(state=new). Ignored for other states.

options.name: subcategory
options.description: The ID or name of the subcategory. If not provided, the subcategory from the change is used. Ignored when O(state<>new).
